description: A serene and softly styled bedroom vignette photographed at standing eye-level as a close-up corner composition. A concentrated warm spotlight casts a directed beam downward onto the nightstand surface from above, illuminating the flowers and creating a focused warm pool against the grey wall. Camera is at standing eye-level shooting with a normal-to-telephoto lens, tightly framed on the nightstand and headboard in a vignette composition that reveals the wall, curtain, and bed corner.
